headword: {最終|さいしゅう}{報告|ほうこく}

definitions.explanation: The last or definitive report on a project, investigation, or study. Indicates that the findings or conclusions are complete and no further updates are expected.

examples.japanese: {最終|さいしゅう}{報告|ほうこく}は{来週|らいしゅう}{提出|ていしゅつ}します。
examples.english: I'll submit the final report next week.

examples.japanese: {調査|ちょうさ}{委員会|いいんかい}が{最終|さいしゅう}{報告|ほうこく}をまとめた。
examples.english: The investigation committee compiled its final report.

examples.japanese: {最終|さいしゅう}{報告|ほうこく}では、{事故|じこ}の{原因|げんいん}は{設備|せつび}の{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}にあると{結論|けつろん}づけられた。
examples.english: The final report concluded that the cause of the accident was deterioration of the equipment.

notes:
Composed of {最終|さいしゅう} (final, last) and {報告|ほうこく} (report). Used in business, academic, and governmental contexts to distinguish the completed report from earlier interim or progress reports. The prefix {最終|さいしゅう} is productive: {最終|さいしゅう}{結果|けっか} (final result), {最終|さいしゅう}{判断|はんだん} (final judgment), {最終|さいしゅう}{確認|かくにん} (final confirmation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最終|さいしゅう}{報告|ほうこく}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a final report
- {最終|さいしゅう}{報告|ほうこく}をまとめる: to compile a final report
- {最終|さいしゅう}{報告|ほうこく}{書|しょ}: final report document

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}: interim report — a progress report submitted partway through a project
- {経過報告|けいかほうこく}: progress report — focuses on reporting developments over time
- {報告書|ほうこくしょ}: written report — the document itself rather than the act of reporting
